other_failure_modes.name: intra_fold_ranking_loss
other_failure_modes.description: Applying rank normalization to validation predictions within each cross-validation fold forces them into a uniform distribution per fold. For small fold sizes, this heavily quantizes the predictions and destroys inter-fold calibration, leading to a distorted and inaccurate overall OOF metric when the folds are combined.

summary: The agent provides a structurally robust, leak-free cross-validation pipeline with proper placement of scaling and feature selection within the folds. However, it fails to implement any explicit data cleaning checks and relies entirely on a naive unweighted average to combine 11 different models. Additionally, the practice of rank-normalizing validation predictions within small CV folds destroys inter-fold comparability, distorting the overall OOF evaluation.
